description: This file defines structures, enums, and a parser related to speech synthesis directives, particularly focusing on parsing JSON-based configuration from text input into a TalkDirective object with associated parsing logic.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: A data structure representing parameters for speech synthesis directives, including voice, model, speed, and other options.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: A structure encapsulating the result of parsing a text input into a TalkDirective, including the directive, remaining stripped text, and unknown keys.

methods.name: parse(_:)
methods.description: Parses a given text string to extract a TalkDirective configuration if present, handling JSON content within braces.

methods.name: stringValue(_:keys:)
methods.description: Helper method to extract a string value from a JSON dictionary given multiple potential keys.

methods.name: doubleValue(_:keys:)
methods.description: Helper method to extract a Double value from a JSON dictionary given multiple potential keys.

methods.name: intValue(_:keys:)
methods.description: Helper method to extract an Int value from a JSON dictionary given multiple potential keys.

methods.name: boolValue(_:keys:)
methods.description: Helper method to extract a Bool value from a JSON dictionary given multiple potential keys.
